items.writer: verb:item add, verb:item park, verb:item close
items.staleness: change-coupling — an item whose evidence or requirement record pointer no longer resolves

exit.detail: to ITEMS-DONE.md on DONE or DROPPED

items.growth: unbounded-with-reason — ready-cap 10 bounds the SCHEDULED head and the retirement ratio governs growth; a hard cap on the carrier would force silent drops, which is the failure the carrier exists to prevent

done bodies.staleness: none, declared why: a closure record is history — it accumulates, it does not go stale; growth is the exit question, not a staleness one

exit.recording-act: a ledger decision line naming the compacted range
exit.detail: the retire lane folds bodies past the archive horizon into a summary line — WAVE 4, declared now so the kind has no undeclared stage, not implemented

done bodies.growth: unbounded-with-reason — this is the archive — the BACKLOG-DONE.md split of 2026-08-19 exists because 47% of the live carrier was archive; compaction is its control, not a bound

ledger lines.staleness: none, declared why: the ledger is append-only decision history

exit.recording-act: compaction only — a line whose item is DONE and older than the horizon folds into that body's compaction line

ledger lines.growth: unbounded-with-reason — one line per decision event, no bodies

JOURNAL entries.staleness: change-coupling — a journal entry nothing cites is stale, and a law carrying no journal pointer has no basis; both are read against the citing artifact, never against the entry's age

exit.recording-act: the citing law or workflow's pointer is the record; an entry leaves only through the retire lane's compaction, which names the folded range in a ledger decision line

JOURNAL entries.growth: unbounded-with-reason — one entry per incident, so growth is bounded by the incident rate rather than by a cap — and a cap here would drop the lesson that justifies a law still in force

audits.staleness: change-coupling — an audit whose measured artifact has changed past the citation it carries no longer measures anything current

exit.recording-act: none is taken: an audit is append-only historical (design §4 row 1), and the recording act for a superseded measurement is the newer audit citing the one it overtakes

audits.growth: unbounded-with-reason — append-only historical, one file per measurement; §4 row 1 declares the exit never, so the control on growth is that a measurement is only taken when a question needs it

leak-scan.reason: OFF, with the design's own reading (§3.3): the corpus-only scope is right HERE. This repo's own prose — CLAUDE.local.md, the runbooks, the backlog, this declaration — names this machine's home directory throughout as ordinary operating text, so a source-scope class would fire on legitimate work on every push and train the override reflex that kills a guard (law 11). The class stays ON where it is defined: over the harvested fixture corpus, which is the leak direction that matters here because the proxy fronts every session on this machine. OPEN FOR THE OPERATOR: the alternative §3.3 names is ON with an allowlist, which is their scrub call rather than a reading of the design; surfaced in the wave-1d report.
